commitment: It settles on counting season records with COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) rather than distinct players, which drops the 'at least once across all available season records' interpretation.
claim: COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) is the right approach without grouping because each row represents a season record.
check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_per_player FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_fifa_api_id ORDER BY rows_per_player DESC LIMIT 10;
sentence_text: Since each row represents a season record, using `COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id)` seems like the right approach without grouping.
